reviews.classification: source edition, institutional evidence and conditional time/rights mechanisms reconciled
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers all267lines, W1–W4, all WPR9–WPR17 rows, F1–F29, EF1–EF11, X1–X8, spot-check table, exact unread windows and next-pass/owner suggestions. Four windows each contain three whole chapters plus one partial:16chapters/12whole/fourpartial, not17/13/four. Their47973declared Chinese-character word units sum correctly. Window/census/worker-note/spot-checked/integrated/source/runtime states remain distinct. Earlier r039–r145 notes are leads where marked L, not fresh source or accurate-note approval.

F2: Keep the exact Chinese compilation SHA6126274478a95dbe03eb904bc35c409067c7022563e52997a46e98be07b2d70d and serial/nonempty-paragraph convention.1394numbered story chapters and the later serial370–1402resume wording need a manifest crosswalk before selecting a range; counts alone do not authorize an out-of-range read. This pass's only-other-English-file statement is dated, superseded as current availability by PROJECT's English-v1 Klein route. Chinese serials cannot silently become English chapter/paragraph locators or sequel spines. No raw Chinese source was newly read and current source availability was not inventoried.

F3: Civil contract, travel/secrecy/registration restrictions, salary/allowance/advance repayment, initiation, formal field rank, examiner authority and potion digestion are different mechanisms. A stated church waiting rule is not an unavoidable pathway law; EF3 already records a different method. Hedged headcounts and inferred local team sizes are not exhaustive staffing constants. Jurisdiction-by-faith's F2 is L-level in this pass, so a routing implementation cannot call it independently verified without its actual source. Operational sealed-item count varies by mission; grade/clearance/group authorization are not proof every team action has the same equipment or costs. Named bilingual team glosses need stable source identity, not duplicate systems.

F4: Broker custody of both sides, authenticity verification, authority to carry an offer versus bind a seller, informant split, cash/barter terms, agent commission/floor and price comparison are separate. Exact scene quotes can stand alone with context; a few quotes do not prove a market-wide band or require every price to have a measured premium. Different city/class/time and authored bread/bed anchors are compatible variants. New papers/appearance/travel spending/custody/old ties are not a reset that deletes cash, legal obligations or actual actor identity. Keep actual holder, offer, payment and attribution through any selected trade/access adaptation.

F5: Later mind/oath/mask/wish and dangerous-item material retains exact source labels and [S]scope; no designed sealed truth is disclosed. A particular cheap wish item does not prove cheapness predicts danger for every item. Loophole, consent, psychological effect, information clearance, exceptional capability and aftermath require their actual mechanisms, not global prohibitions or mandatory anti-exploit gates. Observed local containment, secrecy requests, headquarters report and evidence return are distinct states; they do not certify every lawful-power use or all institution enforcement.

F6: Existing LTS authored examiner/six-act rate remain prototype divergences where recorded, rather than source contradictions or reasons to rewrite a live campaign. PROJECT/campaign/mechanism owners govern Klein's current route; this historical next-pass list launches no workers or code. Preserve the useful contract-join, funded escrow, source-qualified price/floor, institution rights, travel-paper, attribution and consequence ideas in existing owners. Hospitals/banks/newspapers/markets/Seq9prices/jurisdiction/tier wording and unreviewed source ranges remain scoped gaps. No current runtime/native/source-body/build/browser/save proof, acquisition, worker/thread, deletion, relocation, commit or push is added.
reviews.evidence: Both complete docs read in three bounded untruncated ranges each; named source owners/source adapter read as scoped suppliers. Only COI s109p82–85 was newly read from exact hash/member; selected manifest metadata is not body review.
reviews.reopen: Any selected institution/clock/trade/cast mechanism needs its particular source and current actual consumer/proof; retain source and play gaps without a new mandatory gate.

reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers all289lines, W1–W4, F1–F24, E1–E8, C1–C7, every price/role/search/review/unread row and K2/K3/K6/K8/K13cards. Inclusive chapter ranges are6+7+7+6=26whole chapters, not25;45318declared window words sum correctly. Four-window source depth, the earlier whole-supplied-book lane, unreviewed COI_RULES, selected reopened paragraphs and recognition adapter metadata retain separate evidence scope. Historical author/reader audit approval is not user product adoption.

F2: Supplied English compilation SHAe7d156a15f97b207c141a347a4e048e0db176a7ee3cd9bd3be49d5963621805f, unknown creator/translation/authenticity, missing printed label1026, recorded duplicate-text issue, spine-index versus printed-heading and paragraph convention stay explicit. Selected manifest records109/1025/1026/1050/1051/1052 were inspected as metadata; they do not newly validate all1180members or solve duplicate content. First-novel Chinese or current English-v1 LOTM IDs are not sequel spines. Source scenes, claims and raw indexing are distinct from played/adopted content.

F3: Direct selected source read of s109p82–85 (exact member hash matched) confirms the speaker describes a particular sealed-corruption holder's daily body restoration and retained characteristic/boon changes, while separately discussing resetting a place. It does not supply a generic6a.m.Trier workday, transfer those exceptions to every newcomer or prove the notes-level12dayworld-loop/reset implementation. Keep day/time, individual body restoration, place reset, memory and acquired-change carry sets separate. Detailed late mechanisms remain [S]and no altered designed secret is disclosed. The source receipt records only those four newly read paragraphs, not a chapter/book reread.

F4: Intis versus Loen/Feynapotter/other regions and first novel versus sequel institutions need source-specific roles and era. Relayed first-response staffing is not a statute or fixed encounter quota. Civilian staff/protection, brief shelter, eventual departure and failed protection differ. Baboons Research Society is not Tarot Club; Franca's outside-patron approval is not every member's society rule. Personal rank, card, local team, official registry and remote patron are not interchangeable permissions. Selected remote-patron scenes do not prove nobody from the first cast ever appears physically elsewhere. Zero English-term hits do not establish absence under every translation or anywhere in the canon.

F5: Coppet, verl d'or, five-coppet lick, foreign coin, quoted exchange context, gold mass, deposit versus charge, gross wage versus cut and time-unit costs remain separate. Local source quotes do not become universal prices or funded NPC stock. Characteristic convergence tendencies and a possible specific suppression ability need separate evidence; a higher rank does not automatically both strengthen and cancel the same trend. Sealed-item grade, boon source/continuing support, use count/cooldown, negative consequence and dream-layer limits are separate source questions. Preserve useful funded information work, invitation/entry/exit, actor/agency motive, report/corroboration and ordinary livelihood ideas without imposing copied counts or manual-only play.

F6: The current selected recognition record remains nativeBound=false/unactivated-source-qualified-adapter; its sincerity/registry/appearance methods distinguish believed identity, office entitlement and tracking channel. That source inspection does not prove current whole-repository absence of all COI behavior or certify a new playthrough. Date the old floor-card code census; proposed rights/currency/cast/jobs/power/loop rows are not current completion gates. Tarot/academy/lateHivemind/Purifier/Bureau/market/dream/price windows retain their explicit unreviewed scope. Current PROJECT keeps LOTM first and broader worlds; the retired prestige gate is not revived by this source brief. No gameplay/source-code edit, test/build/browser/native run, save access, new acquisition, worker, deletion, move, commit or push occurs.
